_note: aws ce get-cost-and-usage --time-period Start=2026-04-01,End=2026-05-01 --granularity MONTHLY --metrics AmortizedCost UsageQuantity --filter '{"And":[{"Dimensions":{"Key":"RECORD_TYPE","Values":["Usage","DiscountedUsage","SavingsPlanCoveredUsage"]}},{"Dimensions":{"Key":"USAGE_TYPE","Values":["EBS:VolumeUsage.gp3","EUW1-EBS:VolumeUsage.gp3","EBS:SnapshotUsage","EUW1-EBS:SnapshotUsage"]}}]}' --group-by Type=DIMENSION,Key=REGION Type=DIMENSION,Key=USAGE_TYPE. No commitment applies to EBS, so AmortizedCost equals the unblended charge here. Bill-derived rate = AmortizedCost / UsageQuantity per region: gp3 us-east-1 3300.00/41250 = 0.0800, eu-west-1 1980.00/22500 = 0.0880 USD per GB-Mo. Snapshot rows are shown for completeness: per-snapshot cost comes from the resource-level call (snapshot-cost-by-resource.json), never from VolumeSize x this rate.
